description: This file implements a logging handler for tracking least busy deployments in a model routing system. It manages request counts via caching, logs request events, and selects deployments based on traffic load, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: LeastBusyLoggingHandler
classes.description: A custom logger handler that tracks request counts and selects least busy deployment based on traffic.

methods.name: log_pre_api_call
methods.description: Logs a request before API call, updating request count in cache.

methods.name: log_success_event
methods.description: Logs a successful request, decrementing request count in cache.

methods.name: log_failure_event
methods.description: Logs a failed request, decrementing request count in cache.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a successful request, updating cache.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a failed request, updating cache.

methods.name: _get_available_deployments
methods.description: Helper to select the least busy deployment based on current request counts.

methods.name: get_available_deployments
methods.description: Synchronous method to get least busy deployment for a model group.

methods.name: async_get_available_deployments
methods.description: Asynchronous method to get least busy deployment for a model group.
